Anime4K CNN shader code
https://github.com/bloc97/Anime4K
Copyright (c) 2019-2021 bloc97. All rights reserved.
MIT License (same permission and warranty terms as LICENSE.txt).
Copyright and permission notices are retained in core.js and vendored sources.

This application bundles ImageUpscaler, CNN x2 S/M/L/UL, Clamp_Highlights
and Restore_CNN_UL. The highest 2x preset is Clamp + Restore UL + Upscale UL;
the highest 4x preset appends another Upscale UL pass (a custom game preset).
No GAN, face
restoration, offline texture replacement, or external runtime CDN is used.
Source files are retained in vendor/anime4k/src. Rebuild with:
node scripts/build-anime4k.cjs

Local modification: Clamp_Highlights preserves input alpha instead of forcing
alpha=1, to support transparent animated game models. RGB/model weights are
unchanged. The other upstream shader/upscaler sources are unmodified.
